title: Page 260
transc:
No 3  230 pm.
Beckwith City Pt.  Wash Dec. 31. 1864
Susan Spalding Pine black Carmine Nevada red
sailed for Venus Lundy with Jargon Irving
Arsenic Blackstone sails Kerner Each can bandage
Andrew dunlap floyd pewter canbe cooled &
watered at venus pink Carmine McClellan red
Emerson Hammond Carmine Atlantic red Brown David
sail Kerner all from Warden ---- Its 
Gondola that Dickens or Downing more Insipids
will leave Watkins tumbler or wolf for
same destination Kerner or Kirkwood ---- They
are Gendered if in Globe purple harvards
not hampered yet however ---- Weather on
coast is very bad but those above
named will Gondola be in time & be
sufficient for the purpose ---- Ariel & Cham<deletion>pion</deletion>
pion Each Bates Dayton also Gendered from
Warden impress plump Moscow ---- ---- ----
